title: dryopteris sancta
intro: Dryopteris sancta, commonly known as the Pale Buckler Fern or Royal Fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the Dryopteridaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include the ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory function, and provide antioxidant effects, contributing to its use in treating various health issues. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris sancta include anti-inflammatory, expectorant, and antispasmodic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of this plant are responsible for its therapeutic effects, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
